root_cause_criterion.criterion: At `ph_buf[2] = SetTranslator2(WordToString2(language));`, the nested alphabet-language switch must leave the outer word-level `translator2` slot unchanged while the current frame still carries that translator in `tr`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable execution overwrites `translator2` at the nested letter-language switch, severing the outer translator slot from the live `tr` alias. The fixed execution keeps `translator2` unchanged there because `TranslateLetter()` switches via `translator3` instead.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace records `letter_switch_post.word_translator_slot_after != letter_switch_pre.word_translator_slot_before` while `switch_back_sink` executes; the fixed original records equality at the same protected event.

nodes.state: At the switch-back sink, `TranslateLetter()` still dereferences the outer-frame pointer `tr` when executing `ph_buf[len+1] = tr->phoneme_tab_ix;`.
Immediately before the nested language switch, the global word-level slot `translator2` and the current frame parameter `tr` still name the same outer `Translator *`.

edges.relation: The same outer `tr` pointer recorded immediately after the nested switch reaches the later switch-back sink unchanged, so the sink reads through the carried outer translator object rather than a refreshed alias.
